text:
olivia: Deploy window starting for embeddings-service — rolling v3.14 -> v3.15. Ramp to 10% now.
deploy-bot: Preflight checks OK. Observability hooks enabled. Snapshot: https://dashboards.internal/ramp/1768201234
sanjay: watching p95 + 5xx for /v1/embeddings. will flag if >1.5% 5xx or p95 > 300ms :eyes:
maria: small p95 uptick in eu-west, 150ms -> 260ms, error rate still ~0.2%
kevin: seeing cluster of `502` from embed-12 (pool-5). logs show `upstream reset`, might be transient
ops-bot: Alert: rolling-embed: 5xx spike 1.9% at 2026-06-10T14:12:20Z — traffic-hold policy triggered
olivia: hold ramp at 10% and pause further shifts. pin rollout at canary variant `3.15-canary1`. will add note to release notes
maria: running quick query:
```
SELECT route, status, count(*) FROM http_logs WHERE route='/v1/embeddings' AND ts > now()-5m GROUP BY route,status;
```
maria: results: 502 x 12, 200 x 480
sanjay: 502s concentrated on eu-west embed-12, i'll ssh into host and check for restarts
kevin: `journalctl -u embed-worker` shows oom-killer at ~14:10 on embed-12 — memory pressure after quantize kernel update suspect
olivia: decision: PAUSE rollout. rollback agent on embed-12 to runtime 2.9, pin traffic to v3.14 for eu-west until stable. release-note draft: "Paused rollout due to eu-west embedding 502s; rollback agent on embed-12; monitoring active." :memo:
deploy-bot: Rollout paused. Traffic pinned to v3.14 in region eu-west. Actions created: INC-5123 (rollback embed-12), TASK-7284 (postmortem owner assigned)
kevin: starting rollback now
sanjay: standing by for confirmation — will report p95/error-rate after rollback stabilizes
ops-bot: Follow-up healthcheck scheduled in 5m
olivia: thanks team. if metrics don't normalize we escalate to infra and widen the rollback. i'll update release notes + changelog entry now
